products.title: Natural Sea Sponge
products.descriptionHtml:
Experience a luxurious cleanse with Sea Sponge.

Highly absorbent and silky soft, the Sea Sponge is the finest quality of natural sponge available as it resides in the Mediterranean where cooler sea temperatures create strong, dense sponges. The natural sponge will aid a luxurious cleanse, encouraging a rich lather to cocoon and cleanse the skin and remove impurities and flaky skin

Natural sponges are sustainable care products made of a natural material that grows back very quickly. They thrive ecologically on underwater fields and are harvested in an environmentally friendly manner twice a year. A lot of manual work goes into the creation of a product that takes care of the skin with the natural strength of the sea and makes bathing a sensual beauty ritual.

Directions:

Rinse in warm water after every use and allow to dry where air can circulate. Do not bleach, boil, machine wash or wring – just squeeze gently.

Approximate measurements of the sponge: 12cm in diameter

products.title: Bog Oak Streamline
products.descriptionHtml:
The bog oak we use comes from boglands in Ireland. Because of the nature of the wood it can sometimes result in the finished pen having natural indents or small pieces missing. This occurs in the natural turning process and we do not use artifical fillers as this takes away from the natural product. This product is made from wood and as such any patterns and colour variations is a normal part of any wood product. Bog Oak can vary from  brown to black depending on availability. Shown in Gun Metal clip. 

Donegal Pens was established in 2010 by brothers Rónán & Conor Mc Garvey, then aged just 13 and 10 years. To date the pens are stocked in shops in Ireland, Europe and the US .

Hand crafted wooden pens, turned and assembled in the Donegal Gaeltacht in Ireland.

All pens are individually hand crafted in their workshop at Loughanure, County Donegal. Each pen is unique, receiving personal attention from start to finish and will be a gift to treasure.

The pens are individually turned and polished and then carefully examined to ensure a high quality. They create pens in many types of wood including Bog Oak, Yew, Ash, Elm, Olive, Beech, Cherry, Laburnum, Red Cedar, Purple Heart, Oak, Maple, Pear, Walnut & Spalted Beech.

products.title: Rivesci - Cashew Chilli Crush
products.descriptionHtml:
Cashew Chilli Crush goes perfect with poached eggs, sourdough sandwiches, stir fry, meat medley or fish dish!

Co-Founders Shannon Forrest and Michelin Star trained Chef, Declan Malone are proud to use Irish Rapeseed Oil, Irish Honey and Irish Sea Salt in our Cashew Chilli Crush.

‘Rívesci’ is a play on words whilst also paying homage to Shannon and Declan’s roots. ‘Rí’ is the Irish for King and Shannon’s first home in Clonmel was at King Street Flats. ‘vesci’ is the Latin for food and also acknowledges Declan’s hometown of Abbeyleix, Co.Laois as the ‘de Vesci’ family founded Abbeyleix many moons ago. It can also be recognised as ‘King of Food’, in Shannon & Declan’s eyes anyway!

Describing his symbiotic relationship with his adopted home place, Padraig says ‘’It has everything that a landscape artist would want, there is the sea, the mountains, the rolling bog, and the sky and the light that changes every hour of the day. products.title: Sparkling Wine
products.descriptionHtml:
750ml - Alcohol: 11% ABV

It begins with the creation of an uncarbonated base wine. This wine is then mixed with a measure of sugar and yeast, then put in a large stainless steel pressure tank, This yeast and sugar cause a second fermentation in the closed tank which is held under pressure so the carbon dioxide from the fermentation is forced into the wine. The second fermentation takes 6 weeks, after which our sparkling wine is immediately filtered and bottled.

Pale straw colour. Crisp, fresh and elegant Irish sparkling wine withe notes of apple, citrus and strawberry. Lingering finish with a combination of fresh fruits.

Enjoy on it own or perfect pairing to the classic Irish fish and chips.

Temperature to serve : 6c

products.title: Max Benjamin Candles
products.descriptionHtml:
Max Benjamin Candle provides a long-lasting, pleasant scent with a clean, soot-free flame. The natural wax and cotton wick are carefully combined by hand to produce a 50+ hour burn time. Enjoy a natural and quality home fragrance without the worry of soot or smoke.

Lemongrass and Ginger

This cleansing and invigorating scent is inspired by travels to south-east Asia with the aroma of tropical spices lingering in the air. Natural oils of fresh lemongrass combined with mildly wooded ginger root create a sense of calm and wellbeing.

French Linen Water

A soft floral scent reminiscent of balmy evenings relaxing on the veranda in Provence, sipping a light, chilled Rosé. Featuring oils of lavender, sweet orange, petitgrain and some fresh citrus notes.

White Pomegranate

A seductive and exotic scent inspired by the outdoor markets of Verona, Italy’s most romantic city. Fresh pomegranate infused with exotic rosebud reveals a heart of lily and gardenia. Cassis and vanilla add warmth and sensuality.

Dodici

Our twelfth scent. Recreating starlit nights spent exploring cobblestoned Sicilian streets with the intoxicating aroma of citrus and fragrant herbs wafting on the warm breeze. Top notes of lemon and marjoram tinged with Tuscan lavender and rosemary oil.

Pink Pepper

A rich, exotic fragrance reminiscent of strolling through the heady mid-week markets of Madagascar. Top notes of pink pepper, neroli and pear lead to a heart of jasmine and coffee with rich base notes of vanilla, patchouli and cedarwood.

Acqua Viva

A unique fragrance inspired by Mediterranean family holidays spent on Italy’s Amalfi coast. Top citrus notes of mandarin, orange, lemon, and cassis lead to a deeper heart of cardamom and pepper with underlying base notes of musk, amber and cedarwood.

Italian Apothecary

Our signature scent. Inspired by the evocative blended recipes and fragrance of a Florentine apothecary from a bygone era. Spicy top notes lead to a musky heart of patchouli and clove, with a woody base of amber and sandalwood.

 Irish Leather & Oud

A unique earthy fusion of leather and woody notes influenced by old tanneries from the Irish countryside blended with oud accords from the souks of Dubai.

Discovery Collection - 

Crafted in Ireland using blends of natural waxes with lead-free wicks. Our essential oils are selected by hand from artisan fragrances houses using the purest of time honored ingredients. hand poured in Enniskerry and each of our one wick candles have a minimum burn time of 35 hours.

Discovery Candle Wild Coast Belize 200g.

Fresh notes of the Ocean with soft florals, citrus fruits and the aroma of driftwood on the coastal beaches. With the wind in your hair, inhale and let this aroma take you away!

Discovery Candle Irish Driftwood West Cork 200g.

Characterful wild driftwood lying on stunning beaches release notes of amber, touches of incense with a unique earthiness . A truly wild and natural experience!

products.title: Oatmeal and Coconut Milk - Bath Soak
products.descriptionHtml:
Indulge yourself with a blend of colloidal oatmeal and coconut milk poured over your skin!

Three Hills Colloidal Oatmeal Bath Soak is designed to moisturise your skin as you soak and glide it across your skin.

This bath soak effectively relieves dry, itchy and irritated skin.

Oat is the natural ingredient most recommended by dermatologists. As a skin protectant active ingredient, oatmeal can help restore skin’s normal pH and aid in the maintenance of the skin’s moisture barrier to help prevent and protect dry skin.

Coconut milk (full of healthy beneficial fats, minerals, nutrients) nourishes your skin, gently cleanses and also soothes irritated skin.

The salt packaging looks like plastic but isn’t! It’s made from biodegradable and compostable cellulose derived from wood pulp.

Instructions of use:
When the bath is almost full, add the required amount of mixture into the running hot water and stir. Then sink in, relax and enjoy your soft soothed skin!
Colloidal Oatmeal Bath Soak is sufficient for up to 3-4 full baths.
If you prefer to use a different quantity of bath soak, it will surely last longer.

Weight: 150g

This soak does NOT contain:
• Artificial Colours
• Artificial Fragrances
• Parabens
• Steroids
• Phthalates

products.title: Solaris Tea
products.descriptionHtml:
Indulge in a refreshing cup of Solaris Tea, choose from  a blend of green tea or peppermint that will awaken your senses. Made with only natural ingredients, this delightful tea is not only delicious but also provides a boost of antioxidants and improves digestion. Elevate your tea-drinking experience with Solaris Tea.

 

Sourced from the prestigious Jiangxi Province in China our award-winning Jasmine Green Tea is a First Grade, Spring Flush Green Tea that has been carefully handpicked to keep the whole leaf intact. It is then delicately steamed over whole Jasmine flowers to create its sensual uplifting aroma and flavour. Certified organic, it contains no added aromas or flavours.

What is Jasmine Tea good for? Being rich in antioxidants, it may provide many health benefits. It's been associated with a lower risk of heart disease and it's said to improve mental health. It is also considered a good supplement for those who want to lose weight. 

Now you can enjoy the benefits of whole leaf Tea in the convenience of an individually wrapped, 100% biodegradable, silken tea bag. All our stitched and pyramid teabags are made from biodegradable PLA derived from Corn Starch and are certified non-GMO.


Directions for use
•    Use 1 tea bag per cup (250ml) of 90°C hot water (best filtered)  
•    Infuse for 3 minutes 
•    Re-infuse up to 2 times 

Ingredients
100% Jasmine Green Tea*. *Certified Organic

products.title: Solid Shampoo - Orange Peel and Ylang Ylang
products.descriptionHtml:
A lovely zero-waste alternative to bottled shampoo!

Three HIlls concentrated solid shampoo for all hair types offering a lovely exotic scent. The combination of an intensely sweet, floral fragrance of Ylang Ylang and the fresh, fruity aroma of Sweet Orange oil is complemented by the rich, earthy aroma of Patchouli and therefore more suitable for women. We have added some Turmeric powder to brighten up blonde hair when using the shampoo on regular basis and an Orange Peel Powder which promotes hair shine, softness and flexibility while strengthening the hair at the same time.

Take our solid shampoo with you instead of a regular plastic bottle. They last for months and as they are so small so they save you so much money and space and is earth-friendly, requiring minimal packaging. If you haven’t experienced a solid shampoo, try one, you’ll be glad you did.

No-fuss, no mess. Simple, solid (SLS, SLES free) shampoo does away with wasteful over-packaging and environmental worries in one. Perfect for anyone who loves the planet as much as their hair. Not a gimmick, this rich, solid shampoo for all hair types effectively cleanse and moisturise to leave your hair looking nourished and healthy. 

Shampoo Benefits:

  • Hair is clean and easy to comb
  • It’s easy to use, its shape fits right into your palm, it is light and very convenient for travelling, camping, or carrying wherever you wish to
  • It produces abundant, mild foam that is kind, even to processed hair
  • It’s gentle to your hair and scalp
  • It promotes healthy and shiny hair

These shampoos are economic as each bar keeps on working, lasting so much longer than a bottle of liquid shampoo.

This highly-concentrated shampoo bar weighs roughly 70g (2.47oz) which represents 45 – 50 washes, of course, it depends on your hair length and is similar in usage to 450-500ml (15.2 – 16.9oz) of liquid shampoo.

 

  • Coconut Oil contributes to the better hair quality by delivering the shine, softness and power to the damaged hair
  • D Panthenol improves hair quality, increases shine to hair and reduces a hair breakage as it coats the hair and seals its surface, lubricating the hair shaft and making strands appear shiny
  • Wheat Protein can impart hair repairing properties, improve the ease of hair combing and improve colour deposition and retention of dyes on hair
  • Glycerine is sourced from Rapeseed Oil and it prevents drying of the scalp by helping to restore the skin’s water
  • Orange Peel Powder promotes hair shine, softness and flexibility while strengthening the hair too
  • Turmeric Powder brightens up the blonde hair
  • Ylang Ylang Essential Oil is an effective natural treatment to reduce hair fall caused by stress
  • Sweet Orange Essential Oil has antiseptic and anti-inflammatory properties and can help to renew and repair the scalp and improve hair growth
  • Patchouli Essential Oil can help to treat hair loss and ward off dandruff

How to Use Solid Shampoo:

Circle the bar gently over wet hair once or twice depending on hair length. Use sparingly – a little rub is all you need! Massage from the roots to the ends of the hair. Rinse thoroughly and condition if your hair would like a little extra love.

Please do not allow the shampoo to sit in water between uses. Store in a dry place, ideally in the soap dish.

Packaging: Aluminium Tin

Shampoo Bar Weight: 70g

products.title: Superstar Retinoid Night Oil
products.descriptionHtml:
What is it?
A luxurious retinoid beginner night oil blended with fast-acting retinols in a base of cold-pressed, organic and steam-distilled oils.

What does it do?
Diminishes the appearance of fine lines and wrinkles while nourishing and hydrating the skin.

Why is it different?
A luxurious formulation which combines fast-acting and absorbent retinoids so that the actives are effective at low concentration.
The risk of irritation commonly associated with retinoid products is eliminated without compromising the benefits. Supported by a base of cold-pressed grape seed oil, Superstar feels light and nourishing on the skin.
Contains HPR, a new generation of retinoid which has been proven to be less irritating to skin. This form of retinol is already broken down into a form that is easily absorbed by the skin so gets to work on your skin immediately.

products.title: Sweet Lavender Cocoa Butter Moisturiser Bar
products.descriptionHtml:
Sweet Lavender Cocoa Butter Body Moisturiser Bars are solid lotions made with raw cocoa butter, shea butter and coconut oil. Cocoa Butter has a melting point similar to our own body temperature (approx 37degC) and therefore makes the perfect skin emollient. It melts on contact with skin and soaks in to moisturise and nourish.

Sweet Lavender Cocoa Butter Body Moisturiser Bar are designed to be massaged into warm wet skin at the end of the shower. This allows the skin to get the most therapeutic benefit from the nourishing butters and aromatherapy essential oils. Great for dry winter skin. hardened skin patches or as an after–sun treatment. It has an earthy sweet scent created with essential oils of Lavender, patchouli, cedarwood and ylang ylang, The ingredients of this bar are over 90% organic certified and they speak for themselves.

products.title: Beara Bitters
products.descriptionHtml:
Beara Bitters Aromatic: The Craft Cocktail Secret You Didn't Know You Needed

If you’re a lover of cocktails with depth and character, Beara Bitters Aromatic is about to become your new best friend. This small-batch, hand-crafted aromatic bitters is not just a garnish for your gin and tonic; it’s the secret ingredient that transforms an ordinary drink into something extraordinary.

Crafted with precision in the heart of Ireland, Beara Bitters combines a blend of botanicals, spices, and citrus peel, creating a balanced and complex flavor profile that’s rich yet refreshing. The first sip reveals a burst of warm, spicy notes—think cinnamon, clove, and a touch of cardamom—followed by a hint of citrusy brightness that lingers, leaving a beautiful, herbal finish. It’s like a walk through a sun-dappled garden of herbs and spices, with the complexity of a good, aged whiskey.

But what sets Beara Bitters apart from other bitters on the market? It’s the attention to detail and commitment to quality. The makers behind Beara use only the finest, all-natural ingredients, and the bitters are meticulously aged for a perfect, rounded taste. No artificial preservatives or flavorings here—just pure, unadulterated flavor, ready to elevate your next drink.

Whether you’re mixing up a classic Old Fashioned, a Negroni, or experimenting with your own cocktail creations, a few dashes of Beara Bitters Aromatic will add the perfect balance of warmth and complexity. Plus, with its rich amber hue, it’s the kind of product that makes your home bar look as stylish as it tastes.

Ideal for the discerning cocktail enthusiast or anyone looking to add a little sophistication to their drinks, Beara Bitters Aromatic is a must-have for anyone serious about their craft cocktails. Your taste buds will thank you.

products.title: White Mausu
products.descriptionHtml:
Elevate your cooking game with White Mausu. These must-have additions to your pantry packs a punch of delicious banging chilli oils and Rāyu, perfect for everyday meals. Experience the flavourful benefits in every dish.

 Peanut Rayu

The original and much loved White Mausu Peanut Rāyu if we had a signature dish this would be it. 

We start by gently frying some garlic so its crisp and crunchy. we roast peanuts and sesame and then add gochugaru ( Korean Chilli Flake) and a house-blend of chilli into the mix. We've got some agave in their to bring sweetness and tamari brings the salt. 

Its a true everyday sauce and has a right-full place alongside nearly every meal. 

 

Peanut Rayu EXTRA HOT 

Our Original got an extra hot face lift.

Adding to our infused base of gochagaru ( Korean chilli flake) and a signature blend of chilli flake we've sourced some delicious chilli d'arbol thats given this some extra oomph. All mixed in with roasted peanuts, sesame and crunchy fried garlic. 

Its an every day sauce for every day food. Its gorgeous on noodles, dumplings and loves to be center stage on a bowl of rice but its equally delightfull on top of morning eggs, drizzled on some leftovers or used as the gateway to eating lots more veg! 

Smoky Chilli Oil

For those of you that know our sauces. This ones a little different its got a lot less bits but no less flavour. The oil has been deeply infused in a two part process and we've used a type of chipotle called Morita chilli to bring that fruity smoky funk. 

Its a chilli oil and its applications are endless all the usuals, bowls of rice, vegetables, beans, on the eggs, drizzled over your steak.

Black Bean Rayu

It's Salty Funky and Hot. 

Chinese Black Bean form the base of this Rāyu.  Mixed with infused chilli and warming spices like star ainse & cinnamon. A little goes along way.
